items.title: Source: Kelce tells Chiefs he's back for 14th year
items.description: Tight end Travis Kelce, a three-time champion with the Chiefs, has informed the team that he's returning for a 14th season with Kansas City, a source told ESPN.

items.title: Commanders avoid contract woes, re-sign Tunsil
items.description: The Washington Commanders and LT Laremy Tunsil have agreed on a new two-year contract extension with $60.2 million guaranteed and a position-best $32.5 million in signing bonuses.

items.title: Sources: Falcons eye Tua after Dolphins cut QB
items.description: The Falcons are expected to pursue Tua Tagovailoa in free agency, sources told ESPN, after the QB was informed that he will be released by the Dolphins.

items.title: Falcons reach deal with TE Hooper, sources say
items.description: The Atlanta Falcons and tight end Austin Hooper have agreed to a one-year, $3.25 million contract, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Bears add ex-Seahawks DB Bryant, sources say
items.description: The Bears have agreed to sign former Seahawks defensive back Coby Bryant to a three-year deal worth $40 million, sources told ESPN.

items.title: Rams add another Chiefs CB, this time Watson
items.description: The Los Angeles Rams have added another former Kansas City Chiefs cornerback, reaching agreement on a three-year deal with Jaylen Watson, agent Collin Roberts of Excel told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Source: Lions to sign ex-Panthers center Mays
items.description: Free agent center Cade Mays, who started 12 games for the Panthers in 2025, has reached an agreement with the Lions, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Source: Likely to Giants, reuniting with Harbaugh
items.description: The Giants have reached an agreement on a three-year deal with former Ravens tight end Isaiah Likely, reuniting him with head coach John Harbaugh, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Ravens reach 3-year deal with Simpson
items.description: The Baltimore Ravens and guard John Simpson have agreed to a three-year, $30 million contract, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Sources: Pats reach deal with pass rusher Jones
items.description: The Patriots have agreed to a three-year, $39.5 million contract with free agent pass rusher Dre'Mont Jones, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Colts re-sign WR Pierce, trade Pittman to Steelers
items.description: The Indianapolis Colts are re-signing wide receiver Alec Pierce but are trading his running mate Michael Pittman Jr. out of town.

items.title: Sources: Bucs adding RB Gainwell, LB Anzalone
items.description: The Buccaneers have reached two-year deals with ex-Steelers running back Kenneth Gainwell and former Lions linebacker Alex Anzalone, sources told ESPN.

items.title: Source: Super Bowl MVP Walker to join Chiefs
items.description: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III has agreed to sign with the Kansas City Chiefs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Source: Etienne to Saints on 4-year, $52M deal
items.description: Former Jaguars running back Travis Etienne Jr., a Louisiana native who felt it important to be near home, will be signing with the Saints, a source told ESPN.

items.title: Panthers land Phillips on 4-year deal, sources say
items.description: Linebacker Jaelan Phillips is signing with the Panthers, according to Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Raiders give C Linderbaum record deal
items.description: Free agent center Tyler Linderbaum reached agreement Monday on a record deal with the Raiders, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Ex-Pack QB Willis, Dolphins reach deal
items.description: Free agent QB Malik Willis, after reviving his career with the Packers, has reached an agreement with the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.

items.title: Jets overhaul D, add LB Davis, two pass rushers
items.description: The New York Jets struck early and often in free agency, reaching agreements with linebacker Demario Davis and edge players Joseph Ossai and Kingsley Enagbare, sources told ESPN.
